name: gpu_sustained_capacity_impairment_watch
description: Checks whether GPU telemetry samples under meaningful observed load stayed within declared capacity-impairment thresholds during a measurement window.

claim.text: The bound GPU node showed no observed sustained-capacity impairment signals across declared clock, throttle, thermal, power, ECC, Xid, and fabric thresholds during the measurement window under meaningful load.

declaration.min_mean_gpu_utilization_pct.probe: declare the minimum mean GPU utilization required before clean telemetry can support the impairment-watch claim
declaration.min_mean_gpu_utilization_pct.why: Idle clean telemetry does not support sustained-capacity evidence.

gpu_impairment_window.samples.probe: export timestamped GPU samples with utilization, clocks, limits, throttle reasons, ECC/Xid deltas, and fabric error deltas
gpu_impairment_window.samples.why: The impairment watch can only be objective when every limiting dimension has named observed values and declared thresholds.

gpu_impairment_binding.gpu_uuids.probe: bind the sampled GPU UUIDs to the node schedule under review
gpu_impairment_binding.gpu_uuids.why: Without UUID binding, impairment telemetry may refer to GPUs outside the financed or declared node.
